Fresh: the source arm's seed-1 process walls on the pilot targets (median per target). Warm: each fresh wall minus (1 - k) x its compile time, k = 0.110 (the main study's G warm over fresh compile time). Expected: provisioning, setup and teardown (source-session medians) plus the job. Worst: the VM lifetime set by the deadline. Prices: the highest of the regions each launcher may use (L4 on demand, H100 Spot).
